title: Check yourself: Measuring accuracy by segment, sampling, and making a confidence score honest

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: Scenario S6, structured data extraction. A pipeline gets 97% of extracted values right across a validation set that is mostly typed invoices, and the team plans to drop human checks on all of them. What should happen first?

options.text: Break the results down by document kind and by field name before relaxing oversight
options.says: The overall figure is an average that the large easy segment dominates, so each document type and field is measured on its own before any review is removed.

options.text: Confirm that the model reports high confidence on most of the validation set
options.says: Ruled out because "the model wrote the number, and only a labelled validation set says how often that score is right".

options.text: Double the validation set and confirm that the overall figure holds up
options.says: Ruled out because "A bigger validation set of the same mix gives the same hidden figure".

options.text: Ask the reviewers to confirm the model's answers on a handful of randomly chosen documents
options.says: Ruled out because "a handful of random documents are mostly typed invoices, because random samples reflect the mix".

questions.stem: Scenario S6, structured data extraction. Everything scored 90 or above is accepted untouched. The team wants the true wrong-rate of that stream and an early warning when a supplier changes its layout. Which sampling fits?

options.text: Pull random documents from the whole stream in a single draw, with no regard to kind
options.says: Ruled out because "A single random pull from the whole stream is mostly easy cases".

options.text: Pull the documents that scored just under the cut-off every week
options.says: Ruled out because "Everything below it goes to a person", so those documents are reviewed already.

options.text: Pull random documents of each kind that passed with no human look
options.says: A random draw inside every stratum of the unreviewed stream measures the wrong-rate of automation and exposes a new pattern, as the page puts it: "Drawing the same number per stratum means a rare segment is checked as often as a common one".

options.text: Pull one fixed set of old documents on a regular schedule
options.says: Ruled out because "new kinds of error appear when document formats change", and a fixed set only repeats what is known.

origin.section: Sample the accepted items by stratum
